content.comment_body: Requesting assistance. The setup reads an analog laser distance sensor (4..20mA) and displays a computed tire diameter value on an operator device. The issue is that minor oscillations in the sensor's signal lead to noticeable fluctuations in the calculated result shown to users. Seeking advice on how to record and average the last 10 sensor readings to help stabilize the displayed calculations. System uses [company_name] [product_name] and [product_name].
Here is a potential solution example.
